signal: Playground's childcare management platform crossed 5,000 programs, scaling its self-serve and sales motion across daycares and preschools nationwide

email.body1:
Aaron, saw Playground crossed 5,000 programs on the platform.

At that volume, the bottleneck is usually signal-to-action latency: in-market accounts surface faster than the team can act on them, and clean handoffs slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep, every email auto-logged to your CRM.

I built a signal play for Playground off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Aaron, quick follow-up for Playground.

From a RevOps seat, the lift usually hides in how fast signals turn into a sent, personalized touch, and in the data hygiene around it. Small process changes there compound fast across thousands of accounts.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Aaron, last bit of proof for Playground.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Playground's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Aaron, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know RevOps roadmaps fill up fast and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your stack? I will tailor it to Playground either way.
